messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account does not exist",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the READ of file CUENTAS by DEB-CUENTA returns WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NOTFND), the debit is refused by setting DEB-RESP to '30'.",
  "condition": "WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NOTFND) after reading CUENTAS by DEB-CUENTA",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP to '30'; balance is not changed and no rewrite occurs",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Account not on file\n Given no CUENTAS record exists for account 1234567890\n When a debit of 100.00 is requested for account 1234567890\n Then the response code is '30'\n And no balance is changed"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account type differs from requested type",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the account type on the account (CTA-TIPO) differs from the account type in the debit request (DEB-TIPO), the debit response code DEB-RESP is set to '40'.",
  "condition": "Account found AND CTA-TIPO NOT = DEB-TIPO",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP to '40'; balance is not changed",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Type mismatch\n Given account 1234567890 exists with type 'AHO'\n When a debit is requested for that account with type 'COR'\n Then the response code is '40'\n And the balance is unchanged"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Debit rejected when account is not active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the account is not active (NOT CTA-ACTIVA), the debit is refused by setting DEB-RESP to '10'.",
  "condition": "Account found AND type matches AND NOT CTA-ACTIVA",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP to '10'; balance is not changed",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Inactive account\n Given account 1234567890 exists, the type matches and the account is not active\n When a debit of 50.00 is requested\n Then the response code is '10'\n And the balance is unchanged"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Debit rejected for insufficient balance",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the account balance (CTA-SALDO) is strictly less than the requested debit amount (DEB-MONTO), the debit is refused by setting DEB-RESP to '20'. A debit equal to the balance does not trigger this rejection.",
  "condition": "Account found, type matches, account active AND CTA-SALDO < DEB-MONTO",
  "action": "Set DEB-RESP to '20'; balance is not changed",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Insufficient funds\n Given an active account with balance 80.00 and matching type\n When a debit of 100.00 is requested\n Then the response code is '20'\n And the balance stays 80.00",
   "Scenario: Exact balance\n Given an active account with balance 100.00 and matching type\n When a debit of 100.00 is requested\n Then the debit is accepted and the balance becomes 0.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Successful debit reduces account balance",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When none of the preceding WHEN rejection branches of the evaluation matches (WHEN OTHER), the program performs 1000-DEBITAR: it subtracts DEB-MONTO from CTA-SALDO, rewrites the CUENTAS record from CTA-REGISTRO, and sets DEB-RESP to '00'.",
  "condition": "None of the rejection conditions (30, 40, 10, 20) applies",
  "action": "CTA-SALDO = CTA-SALDO - DEB-MONTO; rewrite the CUENTAS record; set DEB-RESP to '00'",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given an active account with balance 500.00 and matching type\n When a debit of 120.50 is requested\n Then the balance becomes 379.50\n And the response code is '00'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Menu option routing and validation",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "On the payment menu, option '1' transfers control to the payment order program PAGOORD, passing the 13-byte commarea. Option '9' ends the session. Any other option is rejected with the message 'OPCION NO VALIDA' and the menu is redisplayed.",
  "condition": "OPCIONI = '1' -> go to PAGOORD; OPCIONI = '9' -> terminate; any other value -> invalid option",
  "action": "'1': XCTL to PAGOORD with WS-COMMAREA (length 13). '9': PERFORM 9000-TERMINAR. Otherwise: set MENSAJEO to 'OPCION NO VALIDA' and send the PAGOMEN map (data only).",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Option 1 opens payment orders\n  Given the user is on the payment menu\n  When the user enters option '1'\n  Then control transfers to program PAGOORD with the 13-byte commarea",
   "Scenario: Option 9 exits\n  Given the user is on the payment menu\n  When the user enters option '9'\n  Then the terminate routine 9000-TERMINAR is executed",
   "Scenario: Invalid option\n  Given the user is on the payment menu\n  When the user enters option '5'\n  Then the message 'OPCION NO VALIDA' is shown on the menu"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Payment processing sequence stops at first failure",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Input validation runs first; the order is read only if validation left no error. Commission calculation and account debit run together, in that order, only if no error exists after the order read. There is no error check between commission and debit. Registration of the payment and the result screen happen only if no error remains after the debit; otherwise the error screen (8000-ENVIAR-ERROR) is sent.",
  "condition": "Validate input; if OK read the order; if OK calculate commission and debit; if still OK register the payment, otherwise send the error",
  "action": "Run the steps in order and stop at the first error. Registration and the result screen happen only without errors. Otherwise the error screen is sent.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Validation failure prevents debit\n Given channel 'ATM'\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the order is not read, no debit is made and 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Order number must be numeric and non-zero",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "If the order number ORDENI is not numeric or equals zeros, the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is placed in WS-MENSAJE and the HAY-ERROR flag is set.",
  "condition": "ORDENI is not numeric OR ORDENI = ZEROS",
  "action": "Set the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' and flag the request as in error. No order is read and no debit is made.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Non-numeric order number\n Given the order number entered is '12A4567'\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown and the payment is not processed",
   "Scenario: Zero order number\n Given the order number entered is '0000000'\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'NUMERO DE ORDEN INVALIDO' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Allowed account types for payment",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If TIPCTAI is not 'CTE', 'AHO' or 'VIR', the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is moved to WS-MENSAJE and HAY-ERROR is set.",
  "condition": "TIPCTAI NOT = 'CTE' AND TIPCTAI NOT = 'AHO' AND TIPCTAI NOT = 'VIR' (evaluated only when the order number is valid)",
  "action": "Set the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Account type not allowed\n Given a valid order number and account type 'PLZ'\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' is shown",
   "Scenario: Account type allowed\n Given a valid order number and account type 'AHO'\n When the request is validated\n Then the account type check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-010",
  "name": "Allowed channels for payment",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "Payments are accepted only through channel WEB or OFI. If CANALI is neither 'WEB' nor 'OFI', the message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' is set and the request is flagged as in error (HAY-ERROR).",
  "condition": "CANALI NOT = 'WEB' AND CANALI NOT = 'OFI' (evaluated only when the order number and account type are valid)",
  "action": "Set the message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Invalid channel\n Given a valid order number, account type 'CTE' and channel 'ATM'\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'CANAL NO PERMITIDO' is shown",
   "Scenario: Valid channel\n Given channel 'WEB'\n When the request is validated\n Then the channel check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-011",
  "name": "Approval key required for office channel",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "A payment made through the office channel (OFI) must include an approval key. If the key is blank the request is rejected with 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA'.",
  "condition": "CANALI = 'OFI' AND CLAVEI = SPACES",
  "action": "Set the message 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: OFI without key\n Given channel 'OFI' and a blank approval key\n When the user presses ENTER\n Then the message 'CLAVE DE APROBACION REQUERIDA' is shown",
   "Scenario: WEB without key\n Given channel 'WEB' and a blank approval key\n When the request is validated\n Then no key is required"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-012",
  "name": "Order must exist",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The order is looked up by order number and company. If it does not exist the payment is rejected with 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'.",
  "condition": "READ of ORDENES by (company EMPRESAI, order number ORDENI) returns NOTFND",
  "action": "Set the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found\n Given company 00010 and order 0004567 that is not in ORDENES\n When the payment is processed\n Then the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-013",
  "name": "Only pending orders can be paid",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "An order can be paid only while it is in the pending state. Otherwise the payment is rejected with 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "condition": "Order found AND NOT ORD-PENDIENTE",
  "action": "Set the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Already paid order\n Given an existing order whose state is paid\n When the user submits the payment\n Then the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE' is shown and no debit is made"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-014",
  "name": "Entered amount must match order amount",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The entered amount VALORI is converted with FUNCTION NUMVAL and divided by 100 (cents to currency units), and the result is stored in WS-VALOR. If WS-VALOR is not equal to ORD-VALOR, the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' is placed in WS-MENSAJE and the HAY-ERROR flag is set.",
  "condition": "NUMVAL(VALORI) / 100 NOT = ORD-VALOR",
  "action": "Set the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Amount matches\n Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI '00000150000'\n When the payment is processed\n Then the amount check passes",
   "Scenario: Amount differs\n Given order value 1500.00 and VALORI '00000100000'\n When the payment is processed\n Then the message 'VALOR NO COINCIDE CON LA ORDEN' is shown"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-015",
  "name": "Payment commission and total to debit",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Orders of 50,000.00 or more pay no commission. Smaller orders pay 1.00 through channel WEB and 2.50 through any other channel (OFI). The amount debited is the order value plus the commission.",
  "condition": "If ORD-VALOR >= 50000 then commission = 0; else if CANALI = 'WEB' then 1.00; else 2.50. WS-TOTAL = ORD-VALOR + WS-COMISION",
  "action": "Set WS-COMISION and compute WS-TOTAL = ORD-VALOR + WS-COMISION.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Web small order\n Given order value 1000.00 and channel WEB\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 1.00 and total is 1001.00",
   "Scenario: Office small order\n Given order value 1000.00 and channel OFI\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 2.50 and total is 1002.50",
   "Scenario: Large order\n Given order value 50000.00 and channel WEB\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 0.00 and total is 50000.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-016",
  "name": "Debit of customer account and result handling",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The amount WS-TOTAL is debited from account CUENTAI (type TIPCTAI) by a CICS LINK to program PAGODEB. If DEB-RESP is '00' processing continues. If it is '10', the message 'CUENTA INACTIVA' is set and HAY-ERROR is raised. If it is '20', the message 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is set and HAY-ERROR is raised. For any other response, the message 'CUENTA NO VALIDA' is set and HAY-ERROR is raised.",
  "condition": "After calling PAGODEB with account CUENTAI, type TIPCTAI and amount WS-TOTAL: DEB-RESP = '00' success; '10' -> 'CUENTA INACTIVA'; '20' -> 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'; other -> 'CUENTA NO VALIDA'",
  "action": "On '00' continue. Otherwise set the matching message and flag the request as in error.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Insufficient balance\n Given a total of 1001.00 and PAGODEB returns '20'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then the message 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown and the order stays unpaid",
   "Scenario: Inactive account\n Given PAGODEB returns '10'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then the message 'CUENTA INACTIVA' is shown",
   "Scenario: Unknown response\n Given PAGODEB returns '99'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then the message 'CUENTA NO VALIDA' is shown",
   "Scenario: Debit succeeds\n Given PAGODEB returns '00'\n When the debit is attempted\n Then processing continues to payment registration"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-017",
  "name": "Payment registration marks order as paid",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The order number is moved to MOV-ORDEN and PAGOMOV is linked with COMMAREA WS-MOVCOM (length 17). The order is then set to ORD-PAGADA, ORD-MOVIM is set to MOV-NUMERO and ORD-COMIS is set to WS-COMISION. The ORDENES record is rewritten, CA-ULTIMA-ORDEN is set to ORD-NUMERO and a SYNCPOINT is issued. The success message 'PAGO REALIZADO' and the preceding error-free condition are not part of lines 162-172 and need separate citations.",
  "condition": "No error after validation, order read and debit",
  "action": "Call PAGOMOV with the order number. Set ORD-PAGADA, ORD-MOVIM = MOV-NUMERO and ORD-COMIS = WS-COMISION. Rewrite the order, set CA-ULTIMA-ORDEN = ORD-NUMERO and issue SYNCPOINT. Then show 'PAGO REALIZADO' with the order, commission and movement numbers.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful payment\n Given a pending order 0004567, a valid request and a successful debit with commission 1.00\n When the payment is registered\n Then the order is marked paid with its movement number and commission 1.00, the change is committed and 'PAGO REALIZADO' is shown",
   "Scenario: Failed debit\n Given the debit returned '20'\n When the request finishes\n Then the order stays pending and no movement is registered"
  ]
 }
]
